canettii.interpretation: low power (6 canettii-consensus substitution(s)); present in M. canettii but dN/dS not reliable
canettii.source: M. canettii (immediate outgroup, 153 genomes) vs H37Rv, Nei-Gojobori dN/dS over the >=50% canettii-consensus substitutions (annotation_mtbc P10)

ntm.interpretation: conserved across the genus (present in 52/53 non-MTBC Mycobacterium genomes, incl. distant relatives) — an ancient core gene predating the genus radiation
ntm.source: presence/absence by tblastn vs ~53 assembled non-MTBC Mycobacterium genomes (annotation_mtbc P10.2)

phylostratum.interpretation: detected across the class Actinomycetia (beyond Corynebacteriales) but not outside the phylum — an Actinobacteria-level ancient gene
phylostratum.source: cross-genus phylostratigraphy: tblastn vs 13 non-Mycobacterium reference genomes (Mycobacteriaceae>Corynebacteriales>Actinomycetia>outside-phylum) + intra-genus NTM presence (annotation_mtbc P10.3)

rbtnseq_fitness.lead: transposon mutants are specifically depleted under Potassium acetate (carbon-source) (RB-TnSeq log2=-1.46, t=-6.575), i.e. the gene is required for fitness in that condition — candidate involvement in the Potassium acetate-related process/utilisation; 2 specific phenotype(s) total.
rbtnseq_fitness.source: RB-TnSeq 95-condition barcoded transposon screen, Mtb (PLoS Biol 2026, doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.3003529)

literature.summary: No publication mentions this gene in its title or abstract — not under its H37Rv locus tag, not under its gene name, and not under any ortholog identifier. Its annotation rests on sequence/structure evidence, with no primary study behind it.
literature.caveat: This layer CITES the literature and adds context; it does not change the verdict or the function stated elsewhere in this fiche.
